title: gh fleet campaign
description: A campaign describes one change applied across many repositories: which repos to target, what to run in each, and how to open the pull request.

apiVersion.description: Schema version of the campaign file.

name.description: The campaign's identity. It derives the branch name and the PR marker, so renaming it starts a new campaign. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

description.description: Free-form description, available to the PR body template as `.Campaign.Description`.

targets.description: Which repositories the campaign touches. Needs `orgs`, `include.repos`, or both.

orgs.description: Organizations (or users) whose repositories are candidates.

include.description: Filters a candidate must pass. Keys combine with AND; values within a key combine with OR.

topics.description: The repo has any of these topics.

languages.description: The repo's primary language is any of these (case-insensitive).

files.description: Any of these paths (file or directory) exists on the default branch.

search.description: A code search query; only repos with a hit match. Scoped to `orgs` automatically.

repos.description: Repos (`owner/name`) that are always included, bypassing the filters above.

properties.description: Custom property values the repo must have: every listed property must match one of its values (case-insensitive).

exclude.description: Repos to drop. Exclusion always wins, even over `include.repos`.

topics.description: Skip repos with any of these topics.

properties.description: Skip repos whose custom property has any of the listed values.

change.description: What to change in each repository: an ordered list of `steps`, each a shell script (`run`) or a Starlark script (`starlark`). Steps run in order in the same checkout, and variables a step sets are visible to the steps after it.

steps.description: The steps to run, in order.

timeout.description: Default maximum run time of each step per repo, as a Go duration (`30s`, `5m`).

pr.description: How the pull request is opened.

title.description: PR title. A Go template with `.Repo` and `.Campaign`.

body.description: PR body: a file relative to the campaign file, or inline text. A Go template with `.Repo` and `.Campaign`.

base.description: Base branch. Empty means the repo's default branch.

labels.description: Labels to add to each PR.

reviewers.description: Users or `org/team` slugs to request review from.

commit.description: The commit made in each repo.

message.description: Commit message. Defaults to the PR title. A script can override it per repo by writing `$FLEET_OUTPUT/commit-message`.

vars.description: Per-repo variables, available to PR templates as `.Vars` and to scripts as `FLEET_VAR_<NAME>`. Values are built from `default`, then every matching `match` rule in order, then the repo's row in `file`; later sources win.

match.description: Rules that set values on the repos they match, applied in order.

when.description: Which repos the rule applies to. Every key that is set must match; values within a key are alternatives. An empty `when` matches every repo.

topics.description: The repo has any of these topics.

languages.description: The repo's primary language is any of these.

file.description: A `.csv`, `.json`, `.yaml` or `.yml` file of per-repo values, relative to the campaign file. A CSV needs a `repo` column and has one column per variable; JSON and YAML map `owner/name` to an object of variables.

concurrency.description: Repos processed in parallel. `--concurrency` overrides it.

maxOpenPRs.description: Stop opening new PRs once this many campaign PRs are open. 0 means no limit.

step.description: One step of the change. Set exactly one of `run` or `starlark`.

name.description: A label for the step, used in logs and errors.

starlark.description: A Starlark file relative to the campaign file that defines `change(repo)`. It edits files through `repo` with no shell or network access.

run.description: A shell script path relative to the campaign file, or an inline script. Runs with the repo root as working directory.

shell.description: Shell for this `run` step. Defaults to `change.shell`.

env.description: Environment variables for this step, added to `change.env`.

timeout.description: Maximum run time of this step per repo. Defaults to `change.timeout`.
